text: # Postpaid & Enterprise Tariff Catalogue — H2 2026 **Document ID:** TARIFF_POSTPAID_2026H2 **Category:** C23 — Enterprise & Business Services **Department:** Product **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-07-08 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Plan Table | Plan | Rental (₹/month) | Data | Voice | Notes | |---|---:|---|---|---| | Individual 499 | 499 | 75GB/month | Unlimited | 1 free OTT subscription | | Individual 999 | 999 | 150GB/month | Unlimited | 2 free OTT subscriptions, intl roaming pack credit | | Enterprise Pooled 50 | 499/line (min. 50 lines) | 40GB pooled/line | Unlimited on-net | Centralised billing, dedicated Account Manager | ## Eligibility & Activation - Available to new and existing customers within the relevant customer scope (prepaid/postpaid/enterprise). - Activation is instant on successful payment via the app, self-care portal, or an authorised retail outlet. ## Fair Usage Policy (FUP) On exhausting the daily/period data allowance, speeds are reduced to the FUP rate for the remainder of that period; unlimited voice remains unaffected. See KB_C09_fup_data_speed for details. ## Roaming Domestic roaming is included at no extra charge. International roaming requires a separate add-on pack; see the roaming category documentation. ## Renewal & Cancellation - Plans can be renewed manually or via auto-renew (where enabled) before or on the expiry date. - Cancellation before validity expiry does not entitle a pro-rata refund of the base plan price, except where required by policy. ## Taxes & Charges All listed prices are exclusive of applicable government taxes
title: Postpaid & Enterprise Tariff Catalogue — H2 2026
